review_findings: System, user and assistant message content is placed directly inside ChatML bodies; tool data uses a user-role tool_response body. Ordinary assistant action JSON is no longer wrapped in serialized message JSON.

All original non-content message fields, including original roles, names, tool call arguments and tool result IDs, remain exactly recoverable in an indexed JSON metadata sidecar alongside complete tools. Explicit instructions identify metadata as data without raising user/tool authority.

Content escapes ampersand before less-than. Reversing only the two versioned escapes recovers exact original content, including literal entity strings, Unicode and control characters. JSON metadata escapes less-than after serialization. Caller data cannot emit framing delimiters.

A fixed exact-template digest participates in model identity. The old renderer is rejected even when its manifest hashes are recomputed; snapshot schema/profile names do not imply compatibility with different templates.

The preparer records dml-qwen-native-content-chatml-v2. Model weights, tokenizer, architecture admission, greedy generation, request-local cache, action parser, agent policy, corpus, execution limits and qualification gates remain unchanged.

The optional-dependency test fixture now runs guarded dependency admission before imports, yielding intentional optional skips and mandatory-lane failures without heavy imports or writes. This repairs a controlled .[dev]-only defect; no GitHub CI failure was observed.
The new renderer module is included both in the mandatory CPU pytest command and in the no-skips required-module gate.
